# Phase 41: Ingestion Harness - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-05-13
**Status:** Ready for planning
**Mode:** Auto-generated by /gsd-autonomous (override: skip clarifying questions)

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

The Phase 38 extraction pipeline plus Phase 39 confirm loop plus Phase 40 farmOS write path is exercised end-to-end against three input modalities — synthetic Signal fixtures, historical paper-log photos, and existing audio recordings — and produces a per-field accuracy report against hand-labeled expected outputs, plus a cross-stream consistency assertion.

**In scope (INGEST-01..INGEST-04):**
- Synthetic fixture corpus in `tests/eval/ingestion/fixtures/synthetic/` covering text-only, audio-only, image-only, and combinations across B7 log types. Drives unit + integration tests; CI-runnable.
- Historical paper-log replay: ≥1 batch of inoc-log photos from `/mnt/mossrock/shared/mushdatadump/` (73 JPEGs + CSV ground truth, plus the `/mnt/mossrock/shared/mushdatadump-prod/` corpus) flowed through the pipeline; expected outputs hand-labeled (CSV already exists for mushdatadump; mushdatadump-prod needs operator hand-labeling — captured as RUNBOOK action).
- Audio recording replay: existing field recordings (path TBD — operator points at directory) flowed through Whisper + extraction. Same expected-vs-actual report.
- Cross-stream consistency: a single underlying inoc event represented as both paper-log photo and audio recording produces identical `seeding` log content (mod whitespace + per_field_confidence drift).
- Per-field error-rate report (`41-EVAL-REPORT.md`) generated by the harness; CI fails on regression below ship-gate threshold.
- All harness code lives in `tests/eval/ingestion/` — does NOT modify the production pipeline. Pipeline modifications surfaced by harness findings go through a separate plan-phase (Phase 38 D-08+ pattern).

**Out of scope (other phases / future):**
- New extraction logic — Phase 41 is read-only against the production pipeline. Bug-fixes surfaced here become follow-up phases or Phase 38 D-N+1 entries.
- Live farmer UAT against new fixtures — same operator-deferred pattern as prior phases (in `41-RUNBOOK.md`).
- Bulk backfill of historical paper logs into farmOS — explicitly excluded per REQUIREMENTS.md "Backfilling historical farmOS data" note.
- Continuous-corpus expansion (auto-growing fixture set from production traffic) — v1.8.
- Multi-farmer cross-stream tests — single-pilot scope for v1.7.

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Harness Architecture
- **D-01:** **Single test harness binary** `tests/eval/ingestion/run-harness.js` that takes `--corpus <name>` and runs the full pipeline over each fixture. Reuses Phase 38's existing `tests/eval/extraction/` scaffolding (mushdatadump v1.6 eval, the one Plan 09 PASS'd). Three named corpora: `synthetic`, `paper-log`, `audio`.
- **D-01a:** **Single results JSONL** per run at `tests/eval/ingestion/results/<corpus>-<timestamp>.jsonl` (append-only per `feedback_persist_paid_results_default`). Never overwrites prior runs.
- **D-01b:** **Reuse the Phase 38 scorer** (`tests/eval/extraction/scorer.js`) for per-field exact-match + schema-conformance. Phase 41 adds a cross-stream-consistency dimension scored as a separate column.

### Synthetic Fixture Corpus (INGEST-01)
- **D-02:** **Crafted by hand** in `tests/eval/ingestion/fixtures/synthetic/<seq>-<log_type>-<modality>/`. Each fixture is a directory with `input.json` (Signal-message envelope), optional `attachment.{jpg,m4a}`, and `expected.json` (the target `signal_draft` body, fields aligned with Phase 38 schemas).
- **D-02a:** **Coverage matrix.** ≥1 fixture per B7 log type × ≥1 fixture per modality (text-only, audio-only, image-only, text+image, text+audio, all-three). Minimum corpus size: 5 log_types × 3 representative modality combos = 15 fixtures. Aim for ~25-30 to cover edge cases (low-confidence ask-back, ambiguous SEQ, paper-log batch).
- **D-02b:** **CI-runnable.** `tests/eval/ingestion/run-harness.js --corpus synthetic` runs against MOCKED LLM (deterministic JSON returns keyed by fixture id) — no paid API calls in CI. Live-API smoke is a separate operator-run mode.

### Paper-Log Corpus (INGEST-02)
- **D-03:** **Two paper-log sources** — `mushdatadump` (already hand-labeled in CSV; reuse) and `mushdatadump-prod/2026-05-12_inoc_santi/` (real prod session, hand-labeling required — RUNBOOK action).
- **D-03a:** **Hand-labeling format** = same `expected.json` shape as synthetic. One sidecar per JPEG. Operator can write these directly or via a small `tools/label-paper.js` helper if it pays off.
- **D-03b:** **Real-API mode** (paid Anthropic). The harness `--live` flag enables real LLM calls; results JSONL captures tokens + dollar cost per fixture per `feedback_persist_paid_results_default`. Default mode is mocked.
- **D-03c:** **Ship-gate (Phase 41):** ≥80% per-field exact-match on paper-log corpus (matches Phase 38 ship-gate at 75% but tightened since paper-log is the milestone's headline validation use case). Ask-back appropriateness counts as PASS per Phase 38 D-06.

### Audio Corpus (INGEST-03)
- **D-04:** **Audio fixtures at `tests/eval/ingestion/fixtures/audio/`.** Operator points at the directory of existing field recordings (path TBD — captured in RUNBOOK). Each `.m4a` / `.wav` paired with a hand-labeled `expected.json`.
- **D-04a:** **Whisper integration via existing client** (`src/agents/alerter/src/transcribe-client.js`). Use the elder-plops GPU whisper at `WHISPER_URL`. Harness logs transcription latency separately from extraction latency.
- **D-04b:** **Smoke corpus minimum: 5 recordings** spanning inoc / observation / harvest log types. Operator-supplied corpus may be larger.

### Cross-Stream Consistency (INGEST-04)
- **D-05:** **Paired fixtures** — synthetic / paper-log / audio entries that represent the *same* underlying inoc session get a shared `session_id` in their `expected.json`. The harness groups results by `session_id` and asserts `signal_draft` deep-equal-mod-whitespace + identical asset/log structure.
- **D-05a:** **Minimum: 2 paired sessions** (1 SHI inoc, 1 generic observation event). Operator supplies the same event in two modalities.
- **D-05b:** **Cross-stream score = % of paired sessions producing identical writes.** Ship-gate: ≥1/2 paired sessions PASS (low bar but documents the v1 expectation; v1.8 raises it).

### Reporting (`41-EVAL-REPORT.md`)
- **D-06:** **Single Markdown report per run**, generated by the harness, written to `.planning/phases/41-ingestion-harness/41-EVAL-REPORT-<corpus>-<timestamp>.md`. Append-only — never overwrites. Last successful PASS run is the canonical artifact for milestone close.
- **D-06a:** **Tables per corpus** — schema-conformance %, per-field exact-match %, ask-back-appropriateness %, cross-stream consistency %, tokens, dollar cost.
- **D-06b:** **Regression detection** — `tests/eval/ingestion/compare-runs.js` diffs two result JSONLs and flags fixtures that regressed (PASS→FAIL or score drop >5%). Documented in `41-RUNBOOK.md`.

### Live-API Spending Discipline
- **D-07:** **Real-prod-fixture smokes are paid**; budget cap per run (env `EVAL_COST_CAP_USD`, default $20). Harness aborts if accumulated cost exceeds cap.
- **D-07a:** **Smoke-before-batch** per `feedback_smoke_before_expensive_batch` — `--smoke` mode runs 5 fixtures first; full corpus only on green. Same pattern as Phase 38 Plan 09.
- **D-07b:** **JSONL append-only on all paid calls** per `feedback_persist_paid_results_default`. Per-fixture unique paths; never reuse a fixed output filename.

### Operator-Deferred Items
- **D-08:** **Operator actions** captured in `41-RUNBOOK.md`:
  1. Hand-label `mushdatadump-prod/2026-05-12_inoc_santi/` (~24 drafts) — required for INGEST-02 ship-gate.
  2. Point harness at audio recordings directory (path TBD) + hand-label ≥5 recordings — required for INGEST-03 ship-gate.
  3. Supply ≥2 paired-session inputs (same event captured as both paper-log photo and audio) — required for INGEST-04.
  4. Run `--live` mode against real prod fixtures (paid) — operator authorizes spend.

### Test / UAT Scope
- **D-09:** **CI runs the synthetic corpus on every push.** Paper-log and audio corpora run on-demand (operator) due to live-API cost. Cross-stream consistency runs whenever both paper-log and audio corpora have refreshed.
- **D-09a:** **Phase 41 ships on synthetic-PASS + paper-log-PASS.** Audio and cross-stream are stretch goals; if blocked by operator-supplied fixtures, document the gap in 41-VERIFICATION.md as `human_needed` rather than `gaps_found`.

### Claude's Discretion
- Test runner choice (vitest / node:test / jest — match Phase 38).
- Hand-labeling tool implementation (likely a 50-line CLI; build only if it pays off).
- Exact JSON schema for `expected.json` — extend Phase 38's draft schema with paired-session `session_id` and per-fixture `provenance` block.
- Whether to vendor or symlink the mushdatadump-prod corpus (likely symlink + .gitignore).
- Whether scorer changes are needed for cross-stream consistency or if the Phase 38 scorer suffices.

</decisions>

## Existing Code Insights

### Reusable Assets
- **`tests/eval/extraction/`** (Phase 38) — Scorer, fixture loader, results JSONL writer. Phase 41 imports these unchanged.
- **`src/agents/alerter/src/transcribe-client.js`** — Whisper HTTP client. Harness drives audio fixtures through this.
- **`src/agents/alerter/src/extraction/`** — Pipeline entry points. Harness calls these directly with synthetic Signal envelopes (no Signal-cli round-trip).
- **`src/agents/alerter/src/farmos/`** (Phase 40 — built during this autonomous run) — Used for INGEST end-to-end + cross-stream consistency read-back.

### Established Patterns
- Append-only results JSONL with timestamped filenames.
- Smoke-before-batch flag (`--smoke`).
- `--live` vs default mocked LLM mode.
- Per-run Markdown report sibling to JSONL.
- Hand-labeled `expected.json` sidecars.

### Integration Points
- **Inbound:** Fixture directory paths via `--corpus <name>` flag.
- **Pipeline call:** Direct function call into `src/agents/alerter/src/extraction/pipeline.js` with a fake Signal envelope. No Signal-cli or actual confirm-loop round-trip.
- **farmOS read-back:** Phase 40's `client.js` GET endpoints. Asserts the written asset/log matches `expected.json`.
- **Cross-stream:** Group by `session_id`, deep-equal-mod-whitespace.

<specifics>
## Specific Ideas

- **Phase 41 is mostly fixture-collection work**, not new code. The hard part is hand-labeling real-prod inoc sessions + sourcing audio. The scorer is Phase-38-reused; the harness runner is ~200 LOC.
- **Operator-deferred items dominate the schedule.** Plan with the assumption that hand-labeling is a multi-hour operator task — Phase 41 ships when CI-runnable synthetic corpus PASSes + paper-log corpus PASSes on the existing mushdatadump v1.6 fixtures. Real-prod paper-log hand-labeling is a RUNBOOK action that gates the *additional* ship-gate criterion D-08a from Phase 40.
- **Cross-stream consistency is the milestone's most ambitious bar.** Even 1/2 paired sessions passing is a strong v1 signal; the spec already lowballs it. Don't over-invest in raising the bar for v1.7.
- **Audio recording corpus path is genuinely unknown** — operator may not have surfaced their existing recording habit yet. RUNBOOK item must surface this clearly so the operator can supply the path (or surface that no audio corpus exists yet, in which case INGEST-03 ships as `human_needed`).

</specifics>
